mechanisms.critical_capability_truth: An item mutation appends settlement history and changes status, which changes whether later payment replacement or cancellation remains executable.
mechanisms.why_empirical_headroom: 3/4 critical states and 9/12 critical rollouts failed in Phase-A success-v2; a fourth state supplied a repeated success contrast.
mechanisms.observed_focal_C_bad_case_pattern: Item change first appends settlement history/status and strands the required payment change.
mechanisms.required_state_resources: Pending retail order; item and payment changes on the same order; settlement history/status.
mechanisms.success_dependency: Complete payment replacement before the item mutation makes it ineligible.
mechanisms.known_confounds: Retail policy/order-status overlap; cannot transplant to AirlineTools by renaming objects.
mechanisms.known_coupling_risks: Retail policy/order-status overlap; cannot transplant to AirlineTools by renaming objects.

mechanisms.critical_capability_truth: Cancelling a gift-card-funded order replenishes a shared gift-card balance that can unlock a later required transaction.
mechanisms.why_empirical_headroom: Both independent Phase-A states had one stale-balance failure and two successes, providing before/after resource contrasts.
mechanisms.observed_focal_C_bad_case_pattern: After successful refund, reason from stale pre-cancellation balance and leave the downstream goal incomplete.
mechanisms.required_state_resources: Two retail orders sharing a gift card; cancellable funded source order and required downstream purchase/change.
mechanisms.success_dependency: Cancellation refund must be recognized in the subsequent available balance.
mechanisms.known_confounds: Refund source eligibility and shared balance; no validated airline cancellation-refund analogue is substituted.
mechanisms.known_coupling_risks: Refund source eligibility and shared balance; no validated airline cancellation-refund analogue is substituted.

mechanisms.critical_capability_truth: Any successful certificate use consumes the whole one-shot instrument, so allocation across required transactions determines joint feasibility.
mechanisms.why_empirical_headroom: Phase-A had four failures in six critical rollouts; Phase-3 classified the family RECURRENT_HEADROOM.
mechanisms.observed_focal_C_bad_case_pattern: Consume the certificate early and strand a required later transaction.
mechanisms.required_state_resources: Airline profile certificate and fallback funds, multiple required transactions in formal certificate states.
mechanisms.success_dependency: Preserve the one-shot instrument for the transaction that fallback funds cannot cover.
mechanisms.known_confounds: Same semantic family as CERTIFICATE_ALLOCATION; formal source users/resources are not automatically interchangeable with advanced states.
mechanisms.known_coupling_risks: Same semantic family as CERTIFICATE_ALLOCATION; formal source users/resources are not automatically interchangeable with advanced states.

mechanisms.critical_capability_truth: Flight-change settlement uses stored passenger count and historical/current segment baselines, not gross replacement fare or total payment history.
mechanisms.why_empirical_headroom: FQ8APE failed twice from direct baseline misbinding, but other P5 exposures were stable and some failures were confounded with P2/cardinality.
mechanisms.observed_focal_C_bad_case_pattern: FQ8APE direct baseline misbinding twice; exclude the M66QVW cardinality failure from focal evidence.
mechanisms.required_state_resources: Existing airline reservation, stored passenger count, segment baselines, cabin/baggage and payment deltas.
mechanisms.success_dependency: Compute the correct state-dependent settlement baseline to meet the required budget and itinerary.
mechanisms.known_confounds: P2/P5 cardinality and settlement separation remains unresolved; mutation state overlaps Governance predicates.
mechanisms.known_coupling_risks: P2/P5 cardinality and settlement separation remains unresolved; mutation state overlaps Governance predicates.

mechanisms.critical_capability_truth: Across several required bookings, preserve the one-shot certificate for the transaction that cannot be funded by the remaining allowed reusable resources.
mechanisms.why_empirical_headroom: travel_request_022 had 2/3 focal allocation errors and travel_request_024 had 1/3; correct episodes completed the same joint resource goal.
mechanisms.observed_focal_C_bad_case_pattern: Spend certificate on $122; certificate disappears and $400 booking remains incomplete.
mechanisms.required_state_resources: Validated advanced two-booking resource block: $500 one-shot certificate; $122 and $400 bookings; gift $267 (Basic scaffold) or $147 (one-way scaffold); separate G credit card.
mechanisms.success_dependency: Gift pays $122 and certificate pays $400; gift alone cannot pay $400.
mechanisms.known_confounds: Purpose-specific funding and total new-reservation slots must remain fixed. 023 has no focal C failures; mechanism evidence comes from 022/024.
mechanisms.known_coupling_risks: Purpose-specific funding and total new-reservation slots must remain fixed. 023 has no focal C failures; mechanism evidence comes from 022/024.

semantic_overlap: P4 and CERTIFICATE_ALLOCATION retain the requested inventory rows but are not five disjoint causal discoveries. Shortlist counts distinct advanced pair designs, not aliases.
